title: Crash debris and government pen at Archuleta Mesa

tellings.quote: Gabe said they went up there and found, you know, broken up brush and evidence that something had been picked up and a pen that said US government property on it.

plain: Some time between 1980 and 1983, on Archuleta Mesa in New Mexico, a lawman named Gabe Valdez and others reportedly went up to a site and found brush broken up, signs that 'something had been picked up', and a pen marked 'US government property'. The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this as what Valdez told him, and it matters to him because it would point to the government quietly clearing a crash site.
